knowledge:
- key_parameters: singleEnd=speeds up calculations if library layout is already known ;; strandMode=speeds up calculations if library protocol is already known ;; verbose=set to FALSE to suppress progress messages ;; BPPARAM=sets parallel execution threads via BiocParallel to speed up calculations for many BAM files ;; group=colors samples by experimental groups (e.g., gDNA contamination levels) in plot() and plotAlnOrigins() ;; path=specifies the filesystem directory where filtered BAM files will be saved in gDNAtx() and filterBAMtx() ;; txflag=fine-tunes filtering strategy using flags created by filterBAMtxFlag()
- alternatives: RSeQC tool infer_experiment.py for strandedness estimation ;; Integrative Genomics Viewer (IGV) for visual inspection of alignment data
- when_to_use: Appropriate for quality control of RNA-seq datasets (especially total RNA-seq) to check for genomic DNA (gDNA) contamination before downstream expression quantification and analysis.
- pitfalls: Using unstranded libraries can result in NA values for strandedness estimation and classification ;; gDNAx attempts to use at least 200,000 alignments overlapping exonic regions to estimate strandedness, so datasets with fewer exonic alignments may yield less robust estimations ;; gDNA contamination is less of an issue in poly(A) selected RNA-seq libraries but remarkably affects total RNA-seq libraries.

workflows.name: diagnose_and_filter_gdna_contamination
workflows.intent: Diagnose genomic DNA contamination in RNA-seq BAM files and filter out reads of potential gDNA origin.
input: bamfiles (character vector of paths to BAM files)
txdb (TxDb annotation object or package name)
workflows.stages: 1. Load BAM files and TxDb annotation ;; 2. Run diagnostics using gDNAdx() ;; 3. Plot diagnostics using plot(), plotFrgLength(), and plotAlnOrigins() ;; 4. Retrieve diagnostic values using getDx(), getIgc(), and getInt() ;; 5. Estimate and classify strandedness using strandedness() and classifyStrandMode() ;; 6. Filter BAM files to remove gDNA contamination using gDNAtx() or filterBAMtx()
workflows.code:
library(gDNAinRNAseqData)
bamfiles <- LiYu22subsetBAMfiles()
pdat <- LiYu22phenoData(bamfiles)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)
txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene
library(gDNAx)
gdnax <- gDNAdx(bamfiles, txdb)
par(mar=c(4, 5, 2, 1))
plot(gdnax, group=pdat$gDNA, pch=19)
dx <- getDx(gdnax)
plotFrgLength(gdnax)
plotAlnOrigins(gdnax, group=pdat$gDNA)
igcann <- getIgc(gdnax)
intann <- getInt(gdnax)
strandedness(gdnax)
classifyStrandMode(strandedness(gdnax))
tmpdir <- tempdir()
fstats <- gDNAtx(gdnax, path=tmpdir)
